title: Individual Development Plans
manage_intro: Individual Development Plans for the people you govern — including the ones auto-created from a high-potential (blue) 9-box placement. Open a plan to review objectives, sign off, and close actions (which can lift the related skill level).
manage_empty: No development plans for your team yet. They appear here when a high-potential 9-box placement is approved or a cycle generates IDP drafts.
overdue_title: Past its end date and still active
new_intro: Start a draft IDP for one of your people. Pick the skill gaps to turn into objectives — each becomes a SMART objective plus a training action. The plan stays a draft until both you and the employee sign it off.
seed_hint: Choosing a person and creating the plan will let you seed objectives from their gaps on the next step.
no_gaps: No open skill gaps found for this person — you can still create an empty plan and add objectives manually.
seed_gaps_hint: Tick the gaps to turn into objectives (required > current). You can refine them after the plan is created.
my_empty: No individual development plan concerns you yet. An IDP is created by your manager — from a skill gap or a talent placement — then signed by both of you.
complete_open_hint: {{count}} objective(s) still open. To complete the plan anyway, give the reason — open objectives stay as they are, nothing is erased.
complete_ready_hint: All objectives are closed: the plan can be completed.
err_own_plan: You cannot close or move your own development plan.
err_forbidden: You are not authorized to manage this development plan.
err_not_active: This action is only possible on an active plan.
err_open_objectives: {{count}} objective(s) are still open: close them first, or give a reason to complete the plan anyway.
err_stale: This plan was just changed by someone else. Reload the page.
err_not_archivable: Only an active or completed plan can be archived.
err_reason_required: A reason is required to archive an active plan.
err_objective_state: An objective can only be started or marked as achieved.
err_objective_transition: This objective cannot move to that state from its current one.
